references.text: Describes the Gershonites' responsibility in the tent of meeting, which included the tabernacle, the tent and its covering, the curtain, and the hangings
Moses gave wagons and oxen to the Gershonites and Merarites under Ithamar's supervision to transport the tabernacle equipment
Ithamar is mentioned as one of Aaron's sons, who here receives oversight of the Gershonites' service
The Merarites' service was also under Ithamar's supervision, showing his leadership role over both the Gershonites and the Merarites
Ithamar had oversight of the Levites' work at the tabernacle, confirming his administrative role
The clans of the Gershonites (Libni and Shimei) who performed the service mentioned in this verse
